registryCustodian.name: Federal Service for State Registration, Cadastre and Cartography (Rosreestr) / ФГИС ЕЦП НСПД, with Kaspiysk urban-okrug administration as local land-planning custodian
registryCustodian.scope: Rosreestr/NSPD is the national cadastral map and EGRN access route; the Kaspiysk administration publishes local land-allocation and planning documents containing cadastral parcel references.
registryCustodian.evidence: The official NSМD/NSPD public map is the current public cadastral-map route. Kaspiysk administration documents describe formation, surveying, cadastral registration, and publication of land-plot lists within the urban okrug and include EGRN parcel records. This does not prove an anonymous citywide vector download endpoint.
